prediction.method: ordinary least squares with intercept and no regularisation
prediction.split: first twenty selected shots train; final five held out

recovery.method: ordinary least squares on centred grid-border flux; columns are scaled only for conditioning and one additive flux gauge is removed

selection.polarity_screen: shot absent from the landed 603-shot population
selection.rule: first lexicographic shots outside the landed affected-shot set with at least eight finite diverted frames; eight evenly spaced eligible frame indices per shot
